items.name: Battery saver brightness reduction
items.description: Battery saver brightness reduction controls sleep/standby and wake orchestration.
items.shortDescription: Battery saver brightness reduction controls sleep/standby and wake orchestration.
items.longDescription: Adjusts battery saver brightness reduction through sleep/standby and wake orchestration. Lower values usually save power but increase wake delay or reduce throughput headroom.
items.whatItDoes: Writes and tracks battery saver brightness reduction so Falcon can apply, verify, and rollback consistently for this policy family.
items.whyGamersCare: It is mostly a power-behavior control and usually has limited direct gaming benefit.
items.fpsImpact: Average FPS impact is generally minimal.
items.latencyImpact: Direct end-to-end latency impact is usually low.
items.powerImpact: Conservative values favor lower power at the cost of responsiveness.
items.heatImpact: Thermal impact is usually modest unless combined with other aggressive settings.
items.stabilityRisk: Medium when changed without hardware-specific validation.
items.recommendedFor: Only for controlled experiments with rollback ready.
items.avoidIf: Avoid aggressive values on battery-limited or thermally constrained laptops.
